label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Vesksirr ul Meskdhrenn
english: V.7 · The Mirror in the Grain

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Syst gemmest, heth leskest, eth grem vranast.
english: *The fourth summer, fifth spring and sixth winter.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadhom o, Seren Pa Luth, ul sull trenn, gor dhrenn ul et vess sa re yal et rytet kethet. Ul et sull re hethym et greller um et dhysal, eth el et greller sy o.
english: *Laid by me, Seren Two-Inks, on three nights, each the night its carving was known. On all three I held the lamp on the shingle, and it is this lamp.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Trenn Hosast: Sull Orrol, Hos Clem
english: **Part I · Three Roads, One Hour**

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren.
english: Hold the stone, Seren.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et vess nasell ull re runnant et drunnatath ul et myst, hosen drunnath ul stannow deld. Lo o dhrenn re reske Enno eth Della ul sona lest hos gebb. Re sol rellor Enrella ul vimm o dholm hosast. Re hadh Enno et bresk, eth re runn Della. Re ston o hos trenn susk; susk hy ull, nafedh.
english: All that short night the drums knocked in the grey, like mallets in a far quarry. Through it sat Enno and Della in their house of one door. Their mark lay under its first stone. Enno had set the chisel, and Della struck. One course high it stood, and higher it stood never.

label: Romanisation
rom: Garl ul narl re vellora sona ul et parow ull, ul vodh re vellorom hosel.
english: Hand in hand had they come into that courtyard, where I came in alone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et dhess re rarr et scethan lo sull orrol ul hos clem, eth re hresk o et hald lo rerddhald eth lo wridlern. Re yal gor yanna lodhat ul vathur, eth re yal vathurath tul. Orvenna, prassyanna et hald, sa nath garma fedh: re yalda sona, nawrodh, galat sa nath re yaldant prassath fedh tevar.
english: At dawn the fleet came by three roads in one hour, and broke the wall east and north. There were more breaches than pairs. {{Orvenna}} the wall-masters, that never raise their voices, did without a word what no masters ere then had done.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re luska Orvenna ganna hy ullen.
english: They sent a pair apart.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hebb Ormund et vathur rerddhalden lo Enno, eth re hebb Penna et bridlern lo Rella. Lo wisk et bystir re harm Enno um o sest: El hosen hos uld; eth re rig Della et ullen lo, ul haskol: lo yemm garl, eth nahos ullen dem nastathulol.
english: Ormund gave Enno the east breach, and Penna gave Della the north. At the stair-head Enno called back, "It is like being one person," and Della threw him the rest, running: "with four hands and no excuses."

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss et Lodhan hy ullen merr fedheth, eth deld nafedh. El deld bost lusul hald.
english: Seldom apart are the Bonded, and never far. A mile of wall is far.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul rerddhald re rik pedh et hald, eth Enno lo. Nath re veskym o. Re vesk Hale.
english: In the east a shot took the wall, and Enno with it. I did not see it. Hale did.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo wridlern re yalom lo sest Rella, eth et lodh lom. Re hyl ey et tolm dasken, dem rytyl et rellor ul o vimm. Re hadh ey sost et bresk, eth re runn ey; eth nath re varr et garl.
english: At the north I was beside Della with the mortar. The last stone she had turned over, to cut their mark beneath it. She set the chisel herself, and struck, and her hand shook not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re hess et drunn ul et helv, ul et garl.
english: Then the mallet stopped in the air.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vesk ey dem rerddhald. Hy ull re ferr ey pawast, eth re ryt ey et stinel dasken, eth re hadh ey et bresk lo sest et rellor, eth re firr ey, lern um dholm.
english: She looked east. Then she bent again, and cut the last stroke, and laid the chisel by the mark, and lay down with her cheek against the stone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadhom et nind strom um et lodh, hosen cadhant tolmardath. Nath re hyn o tul.
english: I put my thumb to the mortar, as masons do. It was still soft.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re senn ey.
english: She was gone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarr Hale ul haskol, eth et brod hy rerddhald lo; eth nath re vysk o o. Nath re rarr haskard desir fedh.
english: Hale came at a run with the word from the east, and said it not. Never before had a runner come too late.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul ryteth surr nath noss rellor ullen sa re dhunn hos garl o. Ul hedh re raevulom fedh sell et stinel sa re ryt Della hosel.
english: Theirs is the only mark in the annals that one hand finished. By the last light I looked long for the stroke Della cut alone.

label: Romanisation · Seren’s caption
rom: Rellor Enrella, tunn, um vimmlern et tolm bridlernen, hosen re vesk Seren o lo et baegyth dasken
english:
::: native legend_stonwryt_enrella chip
The mark of {{Enrella}}, whole, on the underside of the north stone, as Seren looked upon it by the last of the light
:::

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss seskyl los.
english: Ye cannot tell.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo orlrask re lymm Stannard Enno bost lusul tunn, eth re hadh o o lo ey sest. Lo sona yemm garl sost re hadha Orvenna et tolm bridlernen umonta, et rellor dem vimm. Re ammele Idrenna, sa re hoska Enrella, umo ul ba saed:
english: At nightfall Stannard carried Enno the whole mile, and laid him by her. With their own four hands {{Orvenna}} set the north stone over them, mark down. {{Idrenna}}, that had sealed them, prayed over it in two halves:

label: Romanisation
rom: Vardh, re lodhith pana ul hos, somm nath re hossa sona tul.
english: "God, thou madest these two one ere either drew breath."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal hos tevow lonta hyoth, eth hos tolm hyor; eth nath dreskith sona.
english: "One cradle they had of thee, and one stone of us; and thou wilt not part them."

label: Romanisation
rom: Um et tolm re hadh Ormund et tolm hosast ul et dhyvullat hemm, eth re hadh Penna et hosk umo. Hy ull re wysk et Crenn saedel hy o hovv um hagess umonta, et hosast lo Stonwrytan. Eth ew o hest sona. Re ston Kael lo sest, eth re nydh o sona.
english: Over the stone Ormund began the old jest, and Penna finished it. Then the Captain bound a strip on a pike over them, his first for Stonewrights. They were his company too. Kael stood by it and counted them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hos, re vysk o.
english: "One," he said.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo hylyl et hyll re vellor crynir et movennerd. Re orr Rhyna dem vimm demo, eth re orrom lo ey sest, eth et greller lom. Um et hald ul susk, ul vodh re lumm Enno, re hlenn Halvard et vathur somm re vellent et tolmardath Pa lo Yanna. Re rik nahos et carm hosast, ul lern et hessel ell ul neld. Lo et trenn pawast re vellor et ullen, hosen amm re yal et hosast vellet.
english: At the tide's turn the bearer's plank came in. Rhyna went down to it, and I with the lamp. On the wall above, where Enno had kneeled, Halvard mended the breach while the masons sang the song of the gate. No one took the first voice, before the comma or after it. On the second line the rest came in, as though the first had been sung.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh Rhyna garl um et meskdhrenn, eth re stacorn ey. Ul susk re stacorn Halvard ul hos hoss, eth et birnenn ul o yarl. Re rarr o dem vimm, eth re wrodha sona o: haral et scethan tunn, sceth lodhat lo sceth.
english: Rhyna laid her hand on the grain, and went pale. Above, Halvard went pale in the same breath, trowel in hand. He came down, and they told it: the whole fleet's order, hull bound to hull.

label: Romanisation
rom: Fedh sell re yala velv. Re vessym vodh re yal grest umonta, veth kaeverym re seskym o.
english: Long neither spake. I asked what ailed them, though I think I wist.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hosen sy galdar hald.
english: "It is how we work a wall."

label: Romanisation
rom: Tovv et hos dem stinel et ullen, eth nath noss maver wrodhol umo.
english: "The one waiteth for the other's stroke, and need not be told."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re voll et rytet et hyll ull: Aelthae. Vess ull re seskym et saed hosast. Ael re rytym o hos fedh, ul et Ael'thar. Re rytym et voll, eth nath rytym vodh re haeverym.
english: The carving named that Tide *Aelthae*. That night I knew its first half. *Ael* I had written before, in *Ael'thar*. I have written the name, and I will not write what I thought.

label: Romanisation
rom: Um wirnenn Halvard re yal et lodh ul rhynyl.
english: On Halvard's trowel the mortar was drying.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Trenn Pawast: Vodh re ammadar lont
english: **Part II · What We Taught Them**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul heth, ul ryst myst, re hask scethan um et hald ul et orrol hemm, gor sceth hosel eth bont eth venn. Hy ull re dhyvull et hald tunn, eth re wrodh gor wramm umo, bramman Vellow ul molt et ullen.
english: On a grey spring morning a fleet ran at the wall in the old way, each hull alone and loud and straight. Then laughed the whole wall, and every gun on it spake, Pellow's with the rest.

label: Romanisation
rom: Pellow Vell, et tevel sost: re yal pa wrod lo, dem muldath et hald, gor hos.
english: Pellow of the spire, the youngest, had two words for every man on the wall.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vesk virr.
english: "Look close."

label: Romanisation
rom: Vodh re rarr hy ull, doss o lom hy Hale. Amm re wrodhant o wrammath, re lymm Pellow et sirr dem susk, eth re stacorn wemm ulo. Hy ull et pawast. Hy ull et sullast.
english: What followed, I have from Hale. When his guns had spoken, Pellow lifted his glass, and a sail went pale in it. Then a second. Then a third.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel lurrel so.
english: "They are not green."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hask Hale o. Ul o sestow re hyl Pellow o wrammath dem et myst, naharalat, eth re ston o um et hosk hald, eth et sirr lo.
english: Hale ran it. Behind him Pellow turned his guns on the grey, unbidden, and stood on the parapet with his glass.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re orr et Crenn lo dhrenn et hald, eth lo sest vennuld, gor hos, re harm o: Marr tho dhrun. Nath re vynt o, hosen nath bynt syndalard, ell senn et vorr.
english: The Captain went along the wall, and at each True Man's shoulder gave the call: "Shift your ground." He hurried not, as lamplighters hurry not, lest the taper die.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et myst re rarrant et ganurardath, dem et brammath sa re wrodhant, gor hos, eth nath re orrant hyont. Re hoss gor wramman sa re vellor o demo. El niss hos eth hos.
english: Out of the grey came the hunters, to every gun that had spoken, and would not leave it. Each battery he had reached lived. One at a time is slow.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew et deld sost hyo bramman Vellow, eth et virr sost lo et myst. Demo re rarrant hosast, eth re ston o ul so lern, hosel. Nath re vynt et Crenn.
english: Pellow's was the farthest from him, and the nearest the grey. To his they came first, and it met them alone. The Captain quickened not his pace.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re firr Pellow sennet lo et hosk hald.
english: Pellow lay dead at the parapet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re firr et sirr lo o yarl, eth ew tunn o.
english: His glass lay by his hand, and it was whole.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo hylyl et hyll re hadha Halyna garl um hrynir et scethan ull.
english: At the tide's turn {{Halyna}} laid hands on a plank of that fleet.

label: Romanisation · to the carving
rom: Ul o vimm re yal rytet:
english: Under it was cut: *they strike first and far; they move the guns we find.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss nyculol lo et mesk, re vyskym; eth hy ull re veskym o. Nath nycul et mesk. Re yal o haralat dem gadhol nycul ul ol brener, eth re lynir o.
english: "The wood cannot lie," I said, and then I saw it. The wood lieth not. It was told to make us believe a lie, and it obeyed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rystullant o hyor.
english: "They learned it from us."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re ammadar o lont lo et brammath velv, gor hos.
english: "We taught it them with every silent gun."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re yal brod dem nycul lont. Re hebber hos lont. Ul et rytet ull re yal so wrod demor rytet lyss: Rhenear, et nahunn.
english: They had no word for a lie. We gave them one. Small in that carving was cut their word for us: *Rhenear*, the stone-deaf.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hedh re yaldar stell Vellow, eth re wysk et Crenn saedel umo. Hy ull re hebb o et sirr lo Hale, eth et bramman lo.
english: At dusk we raised Pellow's cairn, and the Captain bound a strip over it. Then he held out the glass to Hale, and the battery with it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel vennuld en, re vysk Hale. Haskom.
english: "I am not a True Man," Hale said. "I run."

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re orrant dem Ruan Vell, o hesterd, eth re yald et Crenn vennuld hyo. Re hadh o et sirr lo et veskow, eth re vesk o ul neld et stell.
english: So they went to Ruan of the spire, his file-leader, and the Captain raised him a True Man. He put the glass to his eye, and looked out past the cairn.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vesk virr, re vysk o.
english: "Look close," he said.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Trenn Sullast: Niltenn sa re ryt lernil umo sost
english: **Part III · The Plan That Carved Its Own Defeat**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul sulv dem et gerd re rarr movennerd, eth ryst tunn rytet ul o volt. Re felmer o ul lern sorenn, eth re lymm et hyll et molt dem et dhysal.
english: In snow to the knee came a bearer, with a whole morrow carved in its heart. We sank it ere noon, and the tide brought the heart in.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew kethyl sell sost o sa re hethe Halyna fedh. Pa fedh re loskom et greller somm nath re wrodha sona o tunn tul; eth ul o rask re yal galat sy:
english: It was the longest knowing {{Halyna}} ever held. Twice I filled the lamp ere they had told it all, and at the end was this:

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rytent lernil umont sost ul et niltenn.
english: Into the plan they had cut their own defeat.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss hos garl ul et rytet ull tunn, eth nel garl redul o.
english: "There is one hand in all that carving, and not a council's."

label: Romanisation
rom: Eth el tevel et garl.
english: "And the hand is young."

label: Romanisation
rom: Veth ew et pa wrod rasken sa re heth ol. Nath re sesk et mesk tevel varn veth hosen et reskow ul vodh hask galat grestet. Ul sy re yal o rytet hosen re yal kaeveret.
english: Yet it was the last two words that held us. To the young wood, *home* had been but whither hurt things run. Here it was cut in on purpose.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vesker ol sull hos um ullen um et greller, hosen vesk verr dem susk amm pess humm ul suress sell o viskhovvath.
english: We three looked at one another across the lamp, as wives look up when men long in fever ask for their boots.

label: Romanisation
rom: Rytent ryst amm sy, hosen ryter.
english: "They carve a morrow now, as we do."

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull es naldar ryst sa nath re rytent demo.
english: "Then let us build a morrow they did not carve for."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re senn et greller um et dhysal, eth nath re loskom o fedh sullast.
english: The lamp went out on the shingle, and I filled it not a third time.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Mymmyleth
english: VI.1 · The Homecomings

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Surr et mymmyleth, lo noth vorr.
english: *The year of the homecomings, at ten fires.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadhant et vennuldath o lo et vorr ul gor hos hy et cummath, ul et vess sa re omm et reskow strom ulo; re hadhom gor hos lo o sest. Re hadh Kael et brodath hosast eth et brodath dasken lo et odh sy, amm re yal et nothast ul varn; eth re nydh o et flennath sa re rytym, ul lern o dholm hosast.
english: *Laid by the True Men at each haven's fire, on the night its Throne fell; I set each down beside it. Kael laid the first words and the last at this hearth, when the tenth was home, and counted my leaves ere he would begin.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hebb et tolm lom. Nath reskym; es stonom.
english: Give me the stone. No, I will stand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo rask et grem re orrar dem vimm lo dhrenn et orrolath hemm um et brunnath: et vennuldath eth so hryrullath ul lern, et tolmardath ul sestow. Lo dhrenn et orrol tunn re hask nynth et sulv lo ol sest. Ul gor hos hy et cummath re resk reskow strom ul molt et haldath ommat, eth re dhovv o.
english: At winter's end we went down by the old roads over the mountains, the True Men and their troops before, the masons behind. All the way the snow-water ran beside us. In every haven a Throne sat among the fallen walls, and waited.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo et odh sy re ryt gor hos hyor um et cumm sa re yal lo. El rytvard en, eth re hethym et noth tunn. Ul vodh re yal uld ommat, re wrodh ullen lo o reskow.
english: At this hearth each of us had sworn for his haven. Oath-keeper am I, and I held all ten. Where a man was fallen, another spake for him.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm sy hunna vollath et cummath, eth ketha so, hy vodh dossant lor pawast.
english: Hear now the names of the havens, and hold them, for they are ours again.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Tavow Hemm.
english: **Eldhythe.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Voss, lo reskow Horlen.
english: *Voss, for Corlen.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo sy re yal haldath hosast et cummath cadhat, eth lo sy stonant pawast. Re felm Molt Hyll ul et wadh sa re rarr o hyo, eth nath re dhald o. Cedh, doss maver umo lymmyl et sulter hosast dem varn? Um Horlen. Firr o ul vimm et stelleth rerddhalden. Hy ull re rarr et sulter ul en narl.
english: Here were the first walls of the havens laid, and here they stand again. The Tide-Heart sank into the sea it came from, and rose not. Who should bring the first boat home? Corlen should. He lieth under the east cairns. So the tiller came to mine hand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hethym nind thenth dem susk, hosen re heth o, veth re wrodh et helvhoss nayalat lom. Re lymmym o dem davow lo hyll et hedh, niss. Hy ull re dhovvom, hosen es dovv o, dem dunnol et wadh.
english: I wet a finger and held it up, as he did, though the wind told me naught. I brought her in on the evening tide, slow. Then I waited, as he would, till the sea had finished.

label: Romanisation
rom: Um et tavow re ston lest en scaelur, eth nath re yal crisur lo. Ul susk et odh brid re yal et sull tolm ryss myst ul et hald tul, eth et tolm vimm sost rellorat ul vodh re runnant et higileth mygurath. Dossant ul en havul vess sy. Re haemerent fedh loskat ul susk vorr sennet.
english: On the quay my grandmother's house stood without a roof. Over the cold hearth the three grey stones were yet in the wall, and the lowest scarred where the ship-masters knocked their pipes. They are in my pack tonight. Long enough have they hung over a dead fire.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Cemm Hyll.
english: **Tidesmeet.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Tamm Sull Heskal.
english: *Tamm of the three spans.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal sull bisk lo, eth re runnar et sull ul et hos kethyl, eth re vymm nahos. Ul vodh re ston et heskal ul molt et sull, re orr Lymmerd Yendeth Clenn dem vimm. Um et cless re hadhom et sull tolm lom ul drenn, hosen lo sest en naeval gor vess et gorrol. El crynir hos heskal. El hinnar sull.
english: Three heads it had, and three we struck in the one holding, and none grew back. Where the middle span had stood, the Bearer of New Branches went down. On the bank I set out my three stones in their order, as by my blanket every night of the war. One span is a plank. Three is a city.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Sedhnell.
english: **Fenholm.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Marl Sedhen.
english: *Marl the fen-born.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vysker gor fedh: hinnar, nayalat veth trenn dasken um et trenn hemm. Vess sy re vysker pawast, eth re dhyvullar. Hosen mesk lilvet re orr Meskdhrenn sa Lilv dem vimm ul et sedh, eth re orr et lilvyl hy ol lodh. Re lymm en scaelur trenn dasken ol lest hy et sedh um ey sestow, eth re senn ey, eth nath re yal o ul varn tul. Re hadhom et tolm loy um et trenn hemm, hosen re haral ey lom. Amm re vessys ey: Ho es ston o? Es dess ey: Nayess.
english: A town is but the last course on the old, we used to say. Tonight we said it again, and laughed. Like a log gone soft the Grain That Rots went down into the fen, and the rot went out of our mortar. My grandmother carried the last course of our house out of the fen on her back, and lived not to see it home. I laid her stone on the old course, as she bade me. Had ye asked her would it hold, she had said, "Perhaps."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re felm o.
english: It hath not sunk.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Eth lo et vorr ull re dhovv et odh hoss Ebba.
english: *At that fire, too, the hearth waited a breath for Ebba.*

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Lurrvard.
english: **Holtward.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Aske Hrisur Lurr.
english: *Aske of the canopy.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul molt et mesketh re wesker Molt Veskrivull ul stonol, sol. Re hadh o o veskrivullath, eth nath re dhald. Ew mesketh so, hos fedh, re vyskym lo en gryrull. Ketha va narl. Nath re yal dannwresk taldat. Re luskar o ul stonol. Re vymm o dem varn.
english: Among the trees we found the Root-Heart standing still. It had put down roots, and would not rise. "These were trees once," I told my men. "Mind your hands." Not an axe was lifted. We left it standing. It had come home.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Kethow Stellath.
english: **Carnhold.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Garvel Runnowath.
english: *Garvel of the smithies.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal Kethow Stellath, sa re wont gor orl, velv. Tolm ul dolm re hresk Meskdhrenn Dholm, eth re rikent stelleth et stannardath hosast o. Ul drunnow brid re runnom et drunndholm hos fedh, dem o hunnol. Re wont et drunndholm venn. Nel bramm et galat hosast sa es naldom umo.
english: Carnhold, that rang all day, was quiet. Stone into stone the Stone-Grain crumbled, and the cairns of the first quarrymen took it. In a cold smithy I struck the anvil once, to hear it. It rang true. The first thing I make on it shall not be a gun.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Tavow Vorr.
english: **Emberhythe.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Harl Orrow sa Vorr.
english: *Harl of the burning shore.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re orr ol dolmard dem vimm dem et sast domm, ul vodh re senn Vorrol hosen drunnow navothat. Umo re hadh o o hrynir vorrat, et crynir sa re vysk: Vorr.
english: Our mason went down to the black crust, where the Burning went out like a forge left untended. On it he laid his charred plank, the plank that said *Burn*.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re vorrom o.
english: I did not burn it.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Grullsorth.
english: **Sandreach.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Ulden Salereth.
english: *Ulden of the galleries.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hos clem re varr et thykir, amm re hresk Gunn ul vimm dem susk ul vimm et kethow rerddhalden, eth re hresk o sost. Amm re yal o sol, re orrom dem vimm dem et saler vimm sost, eth re hadhom rern um et trun. Re hunnom nayalat. Vess sy aedhym ul vimm en grisur tolmen sost.
english: An hour the canyon shook, when the Deep-Beneath burst up under the east keep and broke. When it was still, I went down to the lowest gallery, and laid mine ear to the ground. I heard naught. Tonight I sleep under mine own roof of stone.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Frennvar.
english: **Rimewatch.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Kael, lo reskow Hesk.
english: *Kael, for Hesk.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hinnar uld ullen, nath gadhom o. Hinnar sy, doss maver umom.
english: Another man's city I tell not. This one I must.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et ryst ull re firr et lynth sulv, eth ul et sulv re dhovv Grem Sell.
english: All that morning the mere lay white, and in the white the Long Winter waited.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re ston Hesk um et orrow, eth greller o odha syndalat ul o yarl, lo waegyth et orl. Vran grem re syndal o o ul hedh um ol hald bridlernen, eth re lestir o et vessvar.
english: Hesk stood on the shore with his mother's lamp lit in his hand, in full day. Six winters he had lit it at dusk on our north wall, and the night-watch steered by it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul lern sorenn re orr o hosel um et crest. Hy et orrow re nydhym lusulath Hesk. Lo noth murr eth delv re hess o, ul vodh re ston et hellur strom. Re wrodh et crest ul o vimm, hosen re wrodh o ul et vess sa re lymm o et greller ull hy Frennvar.
english: Ere noon he went out on the ice alone. From the shore I told his steps. At two hundred and twelve he stopped, where the great hall had stood. The ice spake under him, as it spake the night he carried that lamp out of Rimewatch.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vess ull, re heth o.
english: That night it held.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul sorenn re dhald et sulv, eth re rik et crest Grem Sell dem vimm.
english: At noon the white lifted, and the ice took the Long Winter down.

label: Romanisation
rom: Eth re rik et crest Hesk.
english: The ice took Hesk too.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hedh re orrar lo dhrenn et tresk, eth bunthath lor, eth re wesker o reller um et crest, ul vorrol. Rytom um ull. Ston.
english: At dusk we went out along the break with ropes, and found his lamp on the ice, burning. I swear to that.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vymm Hesk dem varn.
english: He came home.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · added in Seren’s hand
rom: Cadhat ul narl Seren: Lo et Kethow vess ull nath re vorr greller um et hald bridlernen. Hy ull re hadh nemm sugornan hos lo ull, eth re syndal ey o, eth re vysk ey: Doss maver vothol reller um hos.
english: ***Added in Seren's hand:*** *At the Keep that night no lamp burned on the north wall. Then a fisher-girl set one there, and lit it, and said, "Someone must keep a light."*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Taldow Helv.
english: **Highreach.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Lanner Gynten.
english: *Lanner of the crags.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re orr Lorr Helv dem vimm hy o henth, eth nath re orr o dem susk pawast. Hy ull re yystym et gynt susk, hosen re vyskym, eth re hossvellym dem et helvhoss. Re rarr et helvhoss. Nath re lymm o hos wemm.
english: The Blood of the Sky came down out of its cloud, and went not up again. Then I climbed the high crag, as I said I would, and whistled for the wind. The wind came. It brought no sails.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Sirrvell.
english: **Glasspire.**

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Ruan, lo reskow Vellow.
english: *Ruan, for Pellow.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul nomm et nyrulath re hresk Lennet hosen vesksirr, eth re vesker ul gor saedel hyo et grellereth sa re lymmer ol sost. Es vesk Pellow o hosast. Doss sirr Vellow lom. Re veskym virr, eth re raevulom o.
english: In the dark of the cellars the Silvered broke like a mirror, and every piece of it showed us our own lamps. Pellow should have seen it first. I have his glass. I looked close, and I looked for him.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Hy ull re hadh Kael o yarlath um et tolm fedh pawast:
english: *Then Kael laid his hands on the stone again:*

label: Romanisation
rom: Vess sy ul et parow re harmom et vollath. Gemmnoth voll, eth hosnoth dem dessyl. Lo voll Horlen re yal et parow velv hos hoss, eth lo voll Vellow. Lo voll Hesk re yal greller syndalat um et hald bridlernen, eth nath re rarr tessyl dem vimm.
english: Tonight in the ward I called the roll. Fourteen names, and eleven to answer. At Corlen's name the ward was quiet a breath, and at Pellow's. At Hesk's a lamp was lit on the north wall, and no answer came down.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss cumm lom, hy vodh re wesk et Crenn en lo orrol. Surr sy re reskym lo noth vorr. Lo vorr gor hos, amm re rarr et tessyl, ew et odh sy sa re hunnom. Gor hos hy et cummath, el Kethow Dhresk o. Rytom um ull. Ston.
english: Of no haven am I, for the Captain found me on a road. This year I sat at ten fires. At every one, when the answer came, it was this hearth I heard. Every haven is Rivenkeep. I swear to that.

label: Romanisation
rom: Noth cumm. Re nydhym so pa fedh, eth new sell.
english: Ten havens. I counted them twice, and it took not long.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*
